title: Kolkata Doctor Case
description:
Time and again we are reminded of how unsafe is our country for a Women, another crime against a medical student has been reported in Kolkata. This crime occurred within the confines of a medical institution, a place that also serves as the workplace for hundreds of doctors and hospital staff and where thousands come to get treatments.
This crime is not only a despicable act by a criminal but also a glaring failure of the entire system. While there have been some findings related to this incident, the question remains—who is truly to blame? What allowed such an event to transpire within the campus of a medical institution? 
Let's delve into these questions and discuss who is responsible.
